description: This file defines a React functional component named FavoriteButton, which manages and displays a favorite status for a specific item identified by 'id'. It uses local state and effect hooks to synchronize the favorite status with external data, and provides a button to toggle this status.

methods.name: FavoriteButton
methods.description: React functional component that renders a button allowing the user to add or remove an item from favorites based on its 'id'.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the button is clicked; toggles the favorite status and updates the component state.
